description: On the blue-covered bed in front of the pillow, there’s a small stack of nested bowls in pastel blue and green. The right hand reaches to the stack, lifts the top light-blue bowl off (right-hand object), and sets it down farther back near the pillow; then the right hand lifts a green bowl from the remaining stack and places it down closer to the front, leaving three bowls unstacked while the left hand stays resting nearby without touching anything.
